name: Southern Controls, inc.
old_description: Southern Controls, Inc. - Distributors of Industrial Controls
about:
Southern Controls, Inc. is based in Montgomery, Alabama, where it operates as a distributor of industrial controls. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed in the available sources.

The firm provides product selection and configuration tools for a range of industrial automation brands. Its online catalog includes configurators for Banner Engineering sensors and light signaling products, Yaskawa drives, Siemens industrial automation equipment, Pro-face human-machine interfaces, PULS power supply units, OMRON automation and control components, Phoenix Contact terminal blocks, relays, power supplies, and Ethernet switches, and NOSHOK instrumentation. These tools allow customers to filter products by technical characteristics and paste product codes from spreadsheets for ordering.

Southern Controls serves industrial customers who require sensors, drives, HMIs, power supplies, relays, and networking hardware for automation and control systems. The product lines suggest a focus on discrete and process manufacturing, though specific industry verticals are not listed.

No public statement from the company describes its founding mission or competitive differentiation beyond the breadth of its supplier portfolio.
